Title: Preview: Azure Media Services Live Streaming and Content Protection

Body.Content: The same live streaming solution that seamlessly delivered the 2014 Winter Olympics and 2014 FIFA World Cup to broadcasters around the world is now available in preview. To protect premium video content, we've introduced Content Protection with static and dynamic encryption and a range of industry-standard encryption options like PlayReady DRM and Clearkey AES. Make your audio and video files accessible and easy to discover with Indexer (now generally available). For more information, please visit the Media Services webpage. For a comprehensive look at pricing, visit the Media Services Pricing Details webpage.
